title: Compliance does not require Secure Boot

report.title: {Items.Count} compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy does', 'policies do')} not require Secure Boot

messages.businessImpact: Without Secure Boot a device can be started from untrusted code, which undermines every protection that runs after start-up.
remediation: Enable Require Secure Boot to be enabled on the device.
Expect a small number of older machines to fail; treat them as a replacement list.
messages.cannotSee: Compliance authored in the Settings Catalog is not read: this tool reads the typed compliance API, so a requirement set in a Settings Catalog compliance policy is invisible here and a tenant that has moved to them is judged only on what it left behind. Whether an unassigned policy is a draft or an oversight is also not visible, and the Assigned to column says which listed policies reach nobody.
